headline: 11 Michigan deals, $42.6M raised — led by Orbion Space Technology, Inc.

top_deals.summary: Orbion Space Technology, Inc., a Houghton-based technology company, filed a $37.1M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $27.1M sold to 25 investors.
UWM Holdings Corp (UWMC) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement; filing cites a figure of ~$25.4M.
Kimball Capital Partners, LP, a Canton-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $15M sold to 16 investors. (Amended filing.)
Quantum Ridge Capital Partners, L.P., a Fenton-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $399.2K sold to 1 investor. (Amended filing.)
Onpark South Pond LLC, a Birmingham-based residential real estate company, filed a $127.5K equity and pooled fund interests offering under Rule 506(b); $127.5K sold to 5 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $42.6M sold across 5 Form D filings this week, down 80% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Orbion Space Technology, Inc. (Houghton, Other Technology) targeting $37.1M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
UWM Holdings Corp (UWMC) disclosed a deal. It was one of 4 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan financial services assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

3 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $15.4M raised so far — led by Kimball Capital Partners, LP (Hedge Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
